name: Gasthof Schupfen
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gasthof Schupfen in Tirol**

Nestled in the heart of the **Alps**, **Gasthof Schupfen** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a cozy, rustic setting. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming guesthouse blends traditional charm with modern comforts, offering a warm retreat after a day of exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**.

Indulge in hearty **Tiroler** cuisine—think crispy **Kaiserschmarrn**, savory **Gröstl**, and perfectly grilled **Schweinsbraten**—all prepared with local ingredients. The menu also features seasonal specialties, from creamy **Käsespätzle** to fresh trout from the nearby rivers.

After a satisfying meal, unwind in the cozy common room with a glass of **Tiroler** wine or a frothy **Schnaps**, or step outside to enjoy the breathtaking mountain views. Whether you're here for hiking, skiing, or simply relaxing, **Gasthof Schupfen** promises an unforgettable stay in the heart of **Tirol**.

**Willkommen im Gasthof Schupfen!**
